title: Severe Weather
seo_title: Kindergarten Severe Weather Worksheets: Forecasts and Staying Safe
standard_text: Ask questions to obtain information about the purpose of weather forecasting to prepare for, and respond to, severe weather.
meta_desc: Free kindergarten science worksheets on severe weather (NGSS K-ESS3-2): thunderstorms, tornadoes, blizzards and floods, weather forecasts and how to stay safe. 100 picture questions with answers.
key_sub: Forecasts help us get ready. Go inside and stay safe.
body_html:
How to think about it

Some weather is dangerous.

  • Forecasts tell us what is coming.
  • Get ready: food, water, flashlight.
  • Go inside and stay safe.
Example

There is a thunderstorm. What should you do?

Lightning is dangerous.

Answer: go inside

Example

Why listen to the forecast?

It tells what is coming.

Answer: to get ready

Common mistakes

  • Standing under a tree in a thunderstorm.
  • Playing in flood water.
  • Thinking forecasts do not help.

faq.a: Dangerous weather like thunderstorms, tornadoes, hurricanes, blizzards, floods and heat waves.
